provenance.python_sources: Exact source URLs and SHA-256 from uv.lock, including PyJWT crypto extra and conditional Windows package.
provenance.rust_sources: Exact Cargo.lock registry versions/checksums from verified crypto/pydantic-core/rpds sdists; graphs include build/test/target-specific entries. Upstream wheel CycloneDX SBOM hashes also retained.
provenance.openssl: Both cryptography50.0.2 wheel producer SBOMs identify OpenSSL4.0.3/sourceSHA. Native Mac FFI and Windows PE static version string agree. OpenSSL bundled by cryptography is distinct from OS TLS libraries.
provenance.cffi: Windows x86/x64 libffi implementation is included in the exact CFFI sdist src/c/libffi_x86_x64; macOS uses system libffi. No separate unpublished version is invented.
provenance.source_access_policy: Entries in sources must be SHA-verified by the collector. Separate source_access links are not claimed as downloaded archive bytes. No application runtime makes these network requests.
